package.name: rtc_controllers
package.description: Robot-agnostic control laws and their YAML schemas for the RTC framework: joint-space PD, task-space velocity (CLIK) and acceleration (operational-space), Cartesian impedance/admittance and cascaded compliance, plus GraspController (adaptive PI force control). Header-only laws for the RT tick and non-RT params/ parsers; the ROS 2 bindings that drive them live in the integration packages.
